sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_player_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 24:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows), min(cols))
    return None

pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"At {pos}")

# Navigate to [26,14]: DOWN, DOWN, DOWN
result = action(['DOWN', 'DOWN', 'DOWN'])
pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"At {pos}")

# Try RIGHT from [26,14]
result = action(['RIGHT'])
new_pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"RIGHT from [26,14]: -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != (26,14)}")

if new_pos != (26, 14):
    pos = new_pos
    print(f"At {pos}")
    # Try RIGHT again
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    new_pos2 = get_player_pos()
    print(f"RIGHT from {pos}: -> {new_pos2}, moved={new_pos2 != pos}")
    if new_pos2 != pos:
        pos = new_pos2
        # Try DOWN
        result = action(['DOWN'])
        new_pos3 = get_player_pos()
        print(f"DOWN from {pos}: -> {new_pos3}, moved={new_pos3 != pos}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
